ShortDescription.Value: Design custom road signs in-game and place them on gantries or posts

Publish.LongDescription:
Design road signs in game and place them on your roads.
- Editor with templates: green guide signs, blue services and brown attraction signs - Interstate, US and state route shields, exit tabs, EXIT ONLY panels, arrows, distances - MUTCD-style automatic layout using the Roadgeek 2014 highway fonts - Up to four signs per structure - Mountings: overhead truss, curved or straight tube spans and cantilevers, roadside posts - Click a road to place: the structure is snapped across the road and sized to it - Click a placed sign to load it back into the editor and replace it - Placed signs are normal props that save with your city
